items.statement: Zero-based merchandising rollout delayed by a quarter or few months; will focus on COCO stores in FY26, targeting top 50% turnover stores.
items.quote: I think the progress that we have seen between Jan and Feb also, I am pretty confident we should get back to the earlier plan, albeit with a lag of a quarter or a few months.

items.statement: Net store additions to return to earlier run rate of 30-40 stores per quarter after another quarter.
items.quote: So, my sense is it will be there for another quarter or so, but then the gross additions will keep happening. Eventually, net will start taking over.

items.statement: Floatz contributes 8-10% of turnover in many stores and is margin accretive.
items.quote: It's now become, in many stores, contributing to almost 8% to 10% of turnover, significantly accretive from a margin perspective.

items.statement: Power brand grew close to double digits led by volume, with new launches Easy Slide and Stamina.
items.quote: Our second largest brand, after Bata continues to grow faster, led by volume growth, almost close to double digits last quarter, and was backed by obviously new launches, Easy slide as well as Stamina.

items.statement: Gross margin expanded by 17 bps due to efficient sourcing and lower discounted sales.
items.quote: So, in terms of the margin, the overall gross margin has expanded by 17 bps. This has come on account of a couple of things. One is tightening of the way we source the product as well as in-house manufacturing.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expanded by 141 bps to 22.7%.
items.quote: EBITDA margin at 22.7%, which also expanded by 141 bps, and while the reported PAT is about Rs. 582 million, which is flat.

items.statement: Collapsed price points in ladies closed footwear from 11 to 3, leading to pairs growth and positive gross margin impact.
items.quote: So, as you can see, there were 11 price points in this category, which is called ladies closed. It has been crashed for ease of decision-making for consumers to only three price points.

items.statement: Volume growth turned positive for the year and quarter, driven by all channels and better EOSS execution.
items.quote: We also saw volume growth after some time, even for the year, as well as for the three months of the quarter that went by, and we want to keep continuing that.

items.statement: Supply disruption in Floatz smoothed out by December, normal from January.
items.quote: We did have some slight amount of supply disruption in the quarter that went by, and now the volumes are pretty large. But it's got smoothed out towards the end of the quarter in December, and January onwards is back to normal.

items.statement: One-time exceptional item of Rs. 11 crores for VRS at a south factory.
items.quote: This one was, partial VRS for a certain section of workers, which was amounting to about roughly Rs. 11 crores, yes. So, that we had taken incorporated.

items.statement: VRS impact on employee cost is about Rs. 2.5 crores per annum.
items.quote: So, it would be about Rs. 2.5 crores per annum.

items.statement: Crossed 600 franchise stores, up from less than 100 three years ago.
items.quote: We did cross the landmark of 600 stores on franchise. This was less than about 100, till about three years back.

items.statement: Top 100 stores targeted for zero-based merchandising contribute about 25% of turnover.
items.quote: But the Top 100 stores that we will want to first attack should be contributing to about 25% of our turnover.

items.statement: Inventory at lowest in eight quarters despite highest availability.
items.quote: So, it's a good mix to get in. Low inventory, high availability, reduced complexity, and also backed by lowest or lower agent inventory.

items.statement: Availability increased by 20 percentage points, with potential for another 10 points.
items.quote: So, it's at 20 points extra than where we were earlier. And within that, the top articles are at 20 points extra. Overall availability keeps inching up further.

items.statement: Foods and FMCG to contribute nearly half of total turnover in next 4 years.
items.quote: This move aligns with our vision to expand the Foods and FMCG business, aiming for it to contribute nearly half of our total turnover in next 4 years' time.

items.statement: Edible oil margin to return to 4-5% range.
items.quote: So broadly, 5.42% is largely an outlier, and we will go back between 4% and 5% range overall.

items.statement: Food business margin to be 8-10%.
items.quote: We have consistently maintained that Food business overall will give between 8% to 10% margin in our business. And we still maintain that, and we are pretty much on course to achieve that.

items.statement: Biscuits yearly growth to be 6-7%.
items.quote: Second is that as a guidance perspective as to what we expect to end the year with, I would imagine that the yearly growth would be anywhere between 6% to 7%.

items.statement: Biscuits growth to return to 15% next fiscal.
items.quote: I think, we should get back to -- in the next fiscal, we should get back to the targeted range of 15%.

items.statement: Dental care category to grow 10-12%.
items.quote: Now having said that, the thing is that it has moved into a new entity, while we expect everything to stabilize in this quarter, but we are reasonably hopeful of maintaining 10% to 12% of growth in this category.

items.statement: HPC business to be fully operational this quarter.
items.quote: But broadly, I would expect that this quarter 4 should be in a fully operational status.

items.statement: Target to increase modern trade and e-commerce share to 12%.
items.quote: We want nearly from current 8% to taking it to 12%. That process is on.

items.statement: Target to cross 2 million retail outlets as direct reach.
items.quote: And the target is that we should cross 2 million retail outlets as a direct reach and that we'll continue to expand and build on.

items.statement: Plan to expand oil palm plantation area to 0.5 million hectares in 5 years.
items.quote: We reiterate our plan to take the area under plantation to 0.5 million hectares over the next 5 years, which will cover about 60% of our requirement.

items.statement: Edible oil margin was 5.42% with INR 60-65 crores one-off inventory gain.
items.quote: So part of this gain of INR 364 crores came through the one-off price inventory gain that we got. But most of the part has been a very natural phenomenon of pass-through of the prices that we maintain.

items.statement: Food segment margin was 7.53%, down from 10.19% QoQ and 10.85% YoY.
items.quote: We made 7.53% margin in this quarter. This is versus 10.19% in the previous quarter and 10.85% in the last year quarter -- same quarter last year.

items.statement: Biscuits EBITDA margin at 11.51%, expected to continue similar trend.
items.quote: But overall, if I were to tell you, in the biscuits category, our EBITDA margin is still at about 11.51%. We still would like to continue this trend and we should end the year with pretty much a similar margin construct.

items.statement: No price increase taken in biscuits; all growth was volume-led.
items.quote: But -- and we've taken no price increase. So in terms of this entirely, all this growth has been largely on the volume side.

items.statement: Urban demand remains sluggish; rural demand on same trajectory.
items.quote: Slow. Itis straight answer. The urban has been slow. And the rural has been pretty much on the same trajectory.

items.statement: Palm oil prices higher than soybean and sunflower, causing volume compression.
items.quote: The second big trigger which drove the change was that, as I mentioned in my call, in the presentation is the palm oil prices for a change went significantly higher than Soybean and Sunflower oil prices.

items.statement: Revised FY25 revenue guidance to INR5,925-6,000 crore due to delayed decisions and exiting lower-value customers.
items.quote: For FY '25, we have revised our revenue guidance to INR5,925 crore to INR6,000 crore due to delayed decision-making and our strategy to exit lower -value customers.

items.statement: Anticipates FY26 revenue growth to INR6,750-7,000 crore, driven by expanding order book and stronger win rate.
items.quote: For FY '26, we anticipate revenue growth to INR6,750 crore to INR7,000 crore, driven by an expanding order book and a stronger win rate from large enterprise and high-value opportunities.

items.statement: On track to meet revised FY25 EBITDA guidance of INR525-535 crore, a 23-25% increase from FY24.
items.quote: Despite the lower revenue guidance for FY '25, we are on track to meet our revised EBITDA guidance of INR525 crore to INR535 crore, reflecting a 23% to 25% increase from FY '24.

items.statement: Expects FY26 EBITDA of INR605-645 crore with margin between 9% and 9.2%.
items.quote: For FY '26, we expect EBITDA to range from INR605 crore to INR645 crore with a margin between 9% and 9.2%.

items.statement: Revised FY25 PAT guidance to INR205-210 crore, reflecting an exceptional impact, still 50% growth over FY24.
items.quote: We have also revised our FY '25 PAT guidance to INR205 crore to INR210 crore, reflecting an exceptional impact. However, this still represents a 50% growth over FY '24.

items.statement: Expects FY26 PAT to grow 30-40% with target of INR265-285 crore.
items.quote: For FY '26, we expect PAT to grow 30% to 40% with a target of INR265 crore to INR285 crore.

items.statement: Order pipeline strengthened to $465 million (INR3,900 crore) as of December 2024; secured $80 million orders this quarter.
items.quote: The order pipeline has strengthened with a sequential increase to $465 million, approximately INR3,900 crore as of December 2024. We have secured $80 million in orders so far this quarter and expect strong momentum to continue into quarter 4 and FY '26.

items.statement: Secured major data center order from largest hyperscaler including 3 large U.S. sites and INR250 crore order.
items.quote: Recently, we secured a major data center order from one of our largest hyperscalers, including 3 large U.S. sites and a INR250 crore order.

items.statement: Expects additional INR200-400 crore orders from hyperscaler for new sites in coming quarters.
items.quote: So we expect order in the range of INR200 crore to INR400 crore additionally from this customer for those new sites in the coming quarters.

items.statement: FY25 EBITDA margins of 8.9% above previous expectation due to improved efficiency and focus on quality of revenue.
items.quote: EBITDA margins of 8.9% for FY '25 are above our previous expectation due to improved efficiency and focus on quality of revenue.

items.statement: Severance costs expected to continue for next 3 quarters to optimize efficiencies.
items.quote: And we are expecting that for next, let's say, 3 quarters at least, we are expecting the severance cost to continue because it's like -- we think that this is over and now we have nothing to do.

items.statement: Expects double-digit growth from Q2 FY26 onwards, reaching 15-17% organic growth for FY26.
items.quote: So fiscal '26, quarter 2 onwards for the next several quarters, getting those double -digit -- high double-digit momentum to lead us into our guidance of 15%, 17% organic growth is what we are confident about in fiscal '26.

items.statement: Data center revenues expected to be about 25% of $2 billion goal in next 3-4 years.
items.quote: So we expect our data center revenues in our $2 billion goal to be in the range of about 25 %-odd as we get into the next 3, 4 years.

items.statement: Data center infrastructure networking gross margin 20-22%, healthcare 25-26%, but both equally accretive to operating income.
items.quote: The margin profile for data center infrastructure, networking from a gro ss level in the range of 20%, 22% whereas if you do a health care, of course, the scale will be much lower in the range of 25%, 26%.

items.statement: Targeting $2 billion revenue by FY29, with organic $1.4-1.5 billion and inorganic remainder.
items.quote: We are targeting 1.5% to 2% of this market to reach $2 billion in revenue by FY '29.

items.statement: Expects to add at least one more customer in $100 million bracket in FY26.
items.quote: So we expect in fiscal '26 to add at least one more customer in the $100 million bracket.

items.statement: India CV outlook: Q4 slightly better than Q3; FY26 more or less flat.
items.quote: On the India CV outlook, we expect Q4 to be slightly better than Q3. FY '26 will be more or less flat.

items.statement: North American CV market expected to grow 10% in second half of year.
items.quote: As of now, the North American CV market is expected to be buoyant with a 10% growth, but in the second half of the year.

items.statement: Ferrous casting business targeting annualized run rate of Rs. 1,000 crores within six to eight quarters.
items.quote: Subject to demand holding up, we should be able to hit an annualized run rate of Rs. 1,000 crores, we are hoping within the next six to eight quarters.

items.statement: Ferrous casting margins expected to increase by 250-300 basis points in next two years.
items.quote: Additionally, we expect to see the margins increase by at least 250 basis points to 300 basis points from where we are in the next two years.

items.statement: Standalone capex for FY26 expected about Rs. 300 crores.
items.quote: No, I would say about Rs. 300 odd crores.

items.statement: Subsidiary investments in India not to exceed Rs. 200-250 crores.
items.quote: Only investments in subsidiaries will be in India, nowhere else. And I do not think that will exceed maybe Rs. 200 crores, Rs. 250 crores at the most.

items.statement: Defense executable order book as of Dec 31 is Rs. 5,700 crores.
items.quote: With order wins of about Rs. 100 crores in Quarter 3, the executable order book now stands as of December 31 is Rs. 5,700 crores.

items.statement: Defense revenue expected close to 40% Y-o-Y growth, maybe slightly less due to delays.
items.quote: So, we had guided that we will see a close to 40% growth Y-o-Y and I think we should be fairly close to that. Maybe a little less than that because of some of the delays in the pro cesses that we had thought will be fast

items.statement: Aerospace revenues expected to reach triple-digits per quarter in FY26.
items.quote: We expect this to go to triple-digits by next year per quarter.

items.statement: JSA expected to scale to Rs. 1,000 crores top-line over next two years.
items.quote: Euro Plus One theme and JSA's strong competence are likely to see the business scale up to Rs. 1,000 crores top-line over the next two years.

items.statement: Overseas losses expected to remain at elevated levels for two more quarters.
items.quote: Yes. I think they'll be in the ballpark. Obviously our attempts will be to try and reduce them. But like I said, we need two quarters more, by which time we will have full clarity on our decision.

items.statement: Tariff impact uncertain; no clarity on calculation or HSM codes.
items.quote: So, we do not know that yet as I told you, we do not know what the tariffs are how they will be calculated. What is the base? What exactly are the HSM codes? We do not know that yet.

items.statement: Oil and gas sector growth driven by infrastructure boom expected once pipeline projects start.
items.quote: So, that is going to lead to a big infrastructure boom in the US. And infrastructure boom in the US in such sectors will lead to a virtuous cycle where a lot of other sectors will get benefits.

items.statement: Aluminum forging business is agnostic to EV or gasoline, no risk from EV trend reversal.
items.quote: No, no because aluminum forging and aluminum, in fact, is going to be common no matter whether it's EV or its gasoline. It's completely agnostic to them.

items.statement: New long-term agreement with European company for landing gear and aerospace components manufacturing in India.
items.quote: And I would like to let you know that we have signed a long -term agreement with a European Company to collabo rate to set up a manufacturing facility to manufacture cutting edge landing gear and other aerospace components for global OEM requirements

items.statement: FY26 revenue guidance of INR2,500 crores maintained.
items.quote: So the guidance given for FY '26 was INR2,500 crores. That -- we maintain the same guidance.

items.statement: FY25 revenue guidance of INR2,000+ crores maintained.
items.quote: I mean, we definitely meet that. And into -- if you see the 9-month results, we are on course to cross like I won't mention the number, but the INR2,000 crore plus guidance was more or less given.

items.statement: New TPU extrusion line at Waluj plant with INR118 crores investment, to be completed in 18 months, production by October 2026.
items.quote: Furthermore, we are pleased to announce that the Board of Directors have approved an investment of INR118 crores, which is a first-of-its-kind TPU extrusion line at our Waluj plant. The new TPU is expected to be completed within 18 months with a planned capacity of 360 LSF, lakh square feet, per annum.

items.statement: Fourth capex of additional PPF line on track, expected completion by September 2025.
items.quote: The fourth capex of additional PPF line is on track and is expected to be completed by September '25.

items.statement: Operating margin guidance of 25% plus/minus 3% maintained.
items.quote: So that we have given a guideline that is always going to remain 25% -- 25% plus/minus 3%.

items.statement: TPU plant expected to improve operating margins by 1.5% to 2%.
items.quote: We expect around 1.5% to 2% improvement in the gross margin -- operating margins.

items.statement: Coloured PPF priced 20% to 25% higher than transparent PPF.
items.quote: But in a like comparative between our products, it is 20% to 25% at a higher price because it has got a value addition in it.

items.statement: Strong demand for PPF from USA, Middle East, and India.
items.quote: Our Paint Protection Film business continues to experience strong demand from key customers in USA, Middle East and India.

items.statement: Expect positive trend in Sun Control Films to continue.
items.quote: We expect this positive trend to continue, further supported by the introduction of innovative products for the auto sector and new grades in the architectural and decorative films segment.

items.statement: Value-added products comprise 85% of product mix.
items.quote: Exports continue to be a strong contributor, comprising approximately 74% to our performance with value-added products comprising 85% of our product mix and playing a key role in our global expansion.

items.statement: US tariff worst-case impact of 2% to 3% on margins.
items.quote: In the worst-case scenario, it will -- it can impact 2% to 3% only.

items.statement: TPU capex to be funded through internal accruals.
items.quote: And given our strong cash flows, we will fund this expansion through internal accruals.

items.statement: Cash surplus of INR572 crores as of December 31, 2024.
items.quote: Our financial position remains strong and we are pleased to report that we have a cash surplus of INR572 crores as of 31st December, 2024.

items.statement: Expect top line growth of 20% to 25%.
items.quote: We expect a top line growth of 20% to 25% on top line.

items.statement: FY25 volume growth likely single-digit, not double-digit.
items.quote: So, to give some guidance, we will be, I think, closing the year definitely with a growth, but more likely a single -digit growth than a double -digit growth.

items.statement: Next year confident of double-digit volume growth.
items.quote: And next year, we are hopeful, I would say, quite confident of a double-digit growth.

items.statement: Q4 volume growth 5-10%.
items.quote: No, no, yes, yes, yes. definitely, definitely. For the quarter, definitely. For the quarter, definitely.

items.statement: Margins to improve going ahead.
items.quote: So yes, I wouldn't put a number to it. But yes, we see improvement in margins going ahead.

items.statement: FY25 capex slightly above INR100 crores; next year similar.
items.quote: So, between INR100 crores to INR150 crores for both the years.

items.statement: 50,000 tons expansion: 25,000 in Q4 FY25, 25,000 in Q1 FY26.
items.quote: So about 25,000 tons roughly will come in this quarter, Q4 FY '25 and the remaining 25,000 will go into Q1 FY '26.

items.statement: Greenfield capacity on hold; no announcement in next 6 months.
items.quote: But I don't think you are going to hear any announcement at least in the next 6 months about a greenfield project.

items.statement: PVC prices likely flattish if no anti-dumping duty.
items.quote: So, if that doesn't come through, we are looking at more or less flattish PVC prices.

items.statement: Expect some dip in pipe realizations due to PVC price drop.
items.quote: So, you can expect some dip in the realizations.

items.statement: Demand bounce expected in next 6 months.
items.quote: But if you look at the next 6 months, then yes, we definitely see a bounce in demand.

items.statement: Target 50% non-agri mix in 4 years.
items.quote: But going to 50 in 4 years is definitely a possibility, definitely. That is the target.

items.statement: Discounting affected Q3 profitability; now withdrawn.
items.quote: So that has affected. It has nothing to do much with the ratio.

items.statement: Land sale gain INR417 crores this year; total INR900 crores.
items.quote: This year, we have a gain of INR417 crores and odd.

items.statement: Net cash surplus around INR2,300 crores as of Dec 31, 2024.
items.quote: The company continues to have a strong balance sheet with a net cash surplus of around INR2,300 crores as on 31st December '24 as compared to INR1,570 crores in the corresponding previous year quarter.

items.statement: Timber costs jumped 8-10% in last 8-9 months; some passed to customers, not all.
items.quote: The timber cost this year we have seen a significant jump of about 8% to 10% on the raw material side in the last 8 to 9 months. We've been able to pass on some of it to our customers, but not the entire part of it.

items.statement: No slowdown seen in raw material inflationary pressure anytime soon.
items.quote: Going forward, I do not see a slowdown in the inflationary pressure on the raw material coming anytime soon.

items.statement: Raw material price challenges expected for at least another year, possibly two.
items.value: two more years or at least another year
items.quote: So, I think for the next two more years or at least another year at the very minimum, there will be a lot of challenges on the raw material price perspective.

items.statement: Demand should start moving in right direction in at least another five to six months.
items.quote: So, I think another at least another five to six months and I think the demand should start moving in the right direction again.

items.statement: Next couple of quarters expected to be a little challenging.
items.quote: I think next couple of quarters, it is going to be a little challenging, but that's my take on this.

items.statement: Muted demand attributed to liquidity restrictions, not demand side; demand should pick up as liquidity improves.
items.quote: The muted demand has been because of challenges, not so much in the demand side, but I think there has been a restriction on the liquidity in the market, which is due to the demand. I think with the measures that the government is putting in place as soon as the liquidity improves, the demand should pick up, but our industry, especially the plywood and the wood panel industries, is a lacquered ind

items.statement: Company rapidly increasing sales team and investing in infrastructure across the country; expects stronger growth in coming future.
items.quote: We are rapidly increasing our sales team and investing in our infrastructure across the country and we expect stronger growth numbers in the coming future.

items.statement: Duro segment grew 5% YoY but declined 7% QoQ in Q3 FY25.
items.quote: The Duro segment for Q3, FY25, saw growth of only 5% on year-on-year basis, but a decline of 7% on quarter-on-quarter basis.

items.statement: Tower segment grew 50% YoY and 30% QoQ in Q3 FY25.
items.quote: Our economical offering segment under the brand name Tower showed a robust growth of 50% on a year-on-year basis for this quarter and a 30% growth on quarter-on-quarter basis.

items.statement: For nine-month period, Duro brand grew 9% and Tower grew 22%.
items.quote: For the nine-month period, the Duro brand segment grew by 9% and Tower by 22%.

items.statement: Gross margin dropped to 34.2% in Q3 FY25 from 35.6% in Q2 FY25 due to higher timber costs and product mix shift.
items.quote: Our gross margin saw a drop from the second quarter. We ended at 34.2% for Q3 FY25 as compared to 35.6% in Q2 FY25.

items.statement: EBITDA margin at 4.9% of sales in Q3 FY25 versus 4.1% same period last year.
items.quote: EBITDA as a percentage stood at 4.9% of sales as compared to 4.1% in the same period last financial year, up from 4.5% in Q2 FY25.

items.statement: Employee expense at 11.3% for the quarter; hiring aggressively to build sales and operations team.
items.quote: The company employee expense stood at 11.3% for the quarter as we continue to hire aggressively to build our sales and operations team.

items.statement: Marketing spend for the quarter stood at a moderated 3.7%.
items.quote: Our marketing spend for the quarter stood at a moderated 3.7%.

items.statement: Revenue from inhouse Rajkot plant at 54.4 crores, up 16% YoY but down 3% QoQ.
items.quote: For the quarter, revenue from our inhouse manufacturing plant in Rajkot stood at 54.4 crores up by 16% year-on-year. However, down by 3% quarter-on-quarter basis.

items.statement: Revenue from contract manufacturing at 35.5 crores, up 7.5% YoY and 2.5% QoQ.
items.quote: Revenue from our contract manufacturing stood at 35.5 crores, a growth of 7½% for the year and up at 2.5% quarter-on-quarter.

items.statement: Confident of a very strong fourth quarter.
items.quote: And we hope and we are very conﬁdent that we will have a very strong fourth quarter.

items.statement: Steady-state domestic growth 9-10%, plus 3-4 percentage points from new products.
items.quote: On a steady state basis we should be able to in the current circumstances, current market condi Ɵons, anywhere between 9 to 10% growth is possible with the introduc Ɵon of our stabilizer technology and the low end market product. I think adding another 3, 4 percentage points to that growth is not unrealisƟc.

items.statement: US operations to just break even this year.
items.quote: No, we will probably just break even.

items.statement: No price increases; prices kept constant.
items.quote: Yeah, we have not increased our prices, we have kept our prices constant.

items.statement: Indian market showing signs of slowing down, customers delaying decisions.
items.quote: So, the Indian market deﬁnitely is exhibiƟng signs of slowing down. There is no doubt about that. But it's not something that I would get worried about. It's not like a signiﬁcant. But there are signs of customers delaying decisions.

items.statement: New low-cost compressor range to launch next financial year, targeting Chinese-dominated low-end market.
items.quote: We have developed a range of machines and in the next ﬁnancial year we will be launching them. They are far more reliable than the Chinese machines and extremely compe ƟƟve from a cost point of view and far be Ʃer in performance in terms of eﬃciency.

items.statement: Stabilizer technology launched; products to market within a month in India, six months globally.
items.quote: We hope the products will start coming out to the market within the month India and within the next six months globally.

items.statement: US tariffs not expected to impact compressors; even if imposed, manageable.
items.quote: Even during the earlier regime, Trump regime, when there were duƟes imposed, compressors were not in that category. So, we don't expect it. So even if it comes, those are business challenges. Those are not going to be game changers, yeah.

items.statement: GST portal downtime caused revenue loss of about Rs 15 crore, shifted to January.
items.quote: It has lost about, I think about 150 million. 15 crores.

items.statement: One-time costs: transport about Rs 5 crore, warranty about Rs 2 crore.
items.quote: It is what Transport is about 5 crores and warranty is about 2 crores. Yeah.

items.statement: Europe growth expected low double digit, potentially more with new products.
items.quote: In terms of growth, I would say low double digit is what is possible. But with these new products that we have we could realis Ɵcally expect a lot more.

items.statement: Expects FY25 turnover of ₹450-500 crores.
items.quote: Given the cleared orders, which were on hold by customers in the previous two quarters and some revenue spillover into the next financial year, we expect the current fiscal year to have a turnover of between ₹450 crores to ₹500 crores.

items.statement: Expects FY26 group revenue of ₹650-700 crores.
items.quote: Putting all this together, definitely, we are well poised to be in the range of ₹650 crores to ₹700 crores at the group level.

items.statement: Expects FY26 standalone revenue of ₹300-350 crores.
items.quote: We may not reach that figure of ₹380 crores, but somewhere we are looking at, let's say, between ₹300 crores and ₹350 crores, we should be able to achieve that.

items.statement: Expects Monga Strayfield FY26 revenue of ₹90-100 crores.
items.quote: But next financial year, Monga Strayfield should contribute anywhere between ₹90 crores to ₹100 crores of revenue.

items.statement: Expects M.E. Energy FY25 revenue of ₹100-110 crores.
items.quote: Against that, M.E. Energy should cross the ₹100 crore mark. So we are looking at between ₹100 crores to ₹110 crores in the current fiscal.

items.statement: Confident of maintaining 20% margin for FY25 at group level.
items.quote: We remain confident of maintaining a margin of 20% for the current fiscal year at group level, thanks to a diversified order book and strong project pipeline.

items.statement: Guides for 20% plus consolidated group margin.
items.quote: So it's better to look at a consolidated group margin, which we are guiding for to be in the 20% plus range rather than focusing on separate entity margins because one synergy benefit we are getting is to leverage the plant facilities across the group now to see what is best suited for manufacturing.

items.statement: Order book as of Dec 31: Kilburn ₹368 crores, M.E. Energy ₹41 crores, group ₹409 crores.
items.quote: As on December 31, Kilburn's order book stands at ₹368 crores with M.E. Energy at ₹41 crores, bringing the group total to ₹409 crores.

items.statement: Bagged orders over ₹35 crores at group level in current quarter so far.
items.quote: In addition, we have also bagged orders over ₹35 crores at group level in the current quarter so far.

items.statement: Enquiry pipeline over ₹2,000 crores: ₹1,400 crores Kilburn, ₹600 crores M.E. Energy.
items.quote: We continue to see strong interest in our offerings with a current enquiry pipeline of over ₹2,000 crores, which includes ₹1,400-odd crores for Kilburn and ₹600 for M.E. Energy across different verticals.

items.statement: Expects to close order intake at ₹500 crores plus at group level.

items.statement: Live events margins at best high single digits.

items.statement: Content acquisition and marketing ratio typically 80:20; 36% charged off in year one.

items.statement: Hopeful remaining two free audio platforms will turn paid over next four to five quarters.
items.quote: This leaves only two players in the market now with free offerings, and we are hopeful that they will also turn pay over the next four to five quarters.

items.statement: Shutting down of Wynk will cause short-term pain.
items.quote: Because of the shutting down of Wynk, there will be short- term pain, but we believe that the closure of their free service is good for the industry in the long run, as it will further motivate the remaining two guys to turn towards paid subscription.

items.statement: Forayed into hip-hop, acquired 130 songs from MTV Hustle Season 4 and signed winner and major contestants as exclusive artists.

items.statement: Board declared interim dividend of Rs. 4.5 per share.
items.quote: Lastly, I am pleased to share that the Board has declared an interim dividend of Rs. 4.5 per share.

items.statement: PBT to show modest growth compared to last year, correct after another four quarters.
items.quote: On an annual basis, our PBT will show modest growth compared to last year, but this is expected to be correct after another four quarters where PBT will also start growing rapidly in sync with the revenue growth.

items.statement: Maintains five-year payback period for new content investment.
items.quote: With all this investment in new content, we maintain our guidance of a five-year payback period, and then an additional 55 years to 75 years of returns coming from this content.

items.statement: Expects turnover to remain same as last year around INR3,200 crores, INR2,500 crores if change orders not finalized; if finalized, will hit INR3,500 crores.

items.statement: All-time high order book of INR11,353 crores as on 31st December 2024, with Consultancy INR5,554 crores and LSTK INR5,799 crores.

items.statement: IOCL Paradip PMC-1 awarded; PMC-2 expected to be awarded in next couple of weeks, around INR700 crores.
items.quote: The PM package 1 on has been awarded to us recently, I think last week, it has been awarded to us. And package number two is expected to be awarded in next couple of weeks.

items.statement: Segment profit around 20% in EPCM jobs and around 5% to 6% in LSTK jobs.
items.quote: In the EPCM job, we are having a segment profit of around 20%. And in the LSTK jobs, our segment profit is around 5% to 6%.

items.statement: Expects substantial increase in turnover in FY26 and FY27 due to revenue recognition pattern.
items.quote: So going forward in the financial year '26, '27, there will be a substantial increase in the turnover. We are expecting an increase in the turnover.

items.statement: Total investment in NRL is INR700 crores plus INR135 crores additional; INR35 crores pending payment.

items.statement: Bina and Kochi refineries thinking of expanding within 1 year.
items.quote: There are two refineries who are sort of thinking of expanding -- thinking of going for the expansion in the times to come. So that would definitely happen within 1 year time. The Bina refinery and the Kochi refinery, both of them would be expanding.

items.statement: BPCL upcoming petrochemical complex in Andhra Pradesh allocated INR5,000 crores for initial green project activities.
items.quote: Then you must have heard about the BPCL upcoming refinery -- upcoming petrochemical complex in Andhra Pradesh, wherein the work has initially -- initial work and they have allocated some INR5,000 crores for the initial green project activities.

items.statement: Confident to maintain similar order inflow next year.
items.quote: Yes. It's not difficult to get that to maintain the similar kind of what we have today achieved should be able to achieve the same kind of business next year too -- with the kind of focus we have shifted and the efforts we are making, we should be able to get.

items.statement: CPCL Nagapattinam expansion project on hold due to land issues.
items.quote: It's -- I think the project is kind of on hold because of the land issues. So, we are yet to hear from them further decision on the project from the IOCL side and CPCL side.

items.statement: West Coast Refinery future uncertain; may not come.
items.quote: West Coast Refinery, we do not know the future of it because we have been hearing like it's always published in the paper that may not come. They might decide to go for two refineries at two different locations. So, we don't see any future at this point of time for this refinery.

items.statement: Cash on books around INR1000 crores at end of Q3.
items.quote: Cash is around INR1000 crores.

items.statement: Infrastructure segment grown from 25% to 44%.
items.quote: You must have seen the infrastructure has grown from earlier 25% to 44% in this segment.

items.statement: Dangote may go for petchem projects by end of next financial year after refinery stabilizes.
items.quote: Almost maybe in years' time, they might go for the petchem. items.statement: Bidding for international consultancy projects worth INR30-50 crores each.
items.value: INR30 crores, INR40 crores, INR50 crores

items.statement: Expects EBITDA margin over 6% for current year, improving significantly next year.
items.quote: We see from this year, as we begin the quarter Q4, Jan to March, the impact of GPI which will start coming in, which is already rolled out, and we see the EBITDA margin ending in the year over 6%.

items.statement: Targets 7-8% EBITDA margin next year.
items.quote: I think 7-8 is a realistic estimate for next year which we are looking at the target and we would see that.

items.statement: Plans to grow 8-10% from FY25 onwards.
items.quote: We see ourselves growing it in the range of 8 to 10% from this year onwards. If you see FY '25 onwards, we see ourselves growing at 8-10%.

items.statement: Aims to grow 10 percentage points above market growth.
items.quote: And if you recall from the last call, we had given an indication that we will grow at a 10% point above the market, which means if the market grows at 10%, we will grow at 11%, if the market grows at 8%, we will grow at 9%.

items.statement: Targets gross margin of 29% by FY27.
items.quote: So, as you said, 29% for '27 is very much in sight and very much doable.

items.statement: Plans capex of 20 crores next year for modernization.
items.quote: Next year also we are keeping a budget of 20 crore CAPEX, which would be mainly on modernization and other initiatives.

items.statement: Plans to open eight new hubs by end of FY2026.
items.quote: we plan to open eight new hubs by the end of Financial Year 2026, details of which are shared in the Investor Presentation.

items.statement: General price increase realization is single-digit, improving month-on-month.
items.quote: As of today, we have realized a single-digit GPI realization, and that will improve month-on-month into March, and as I said, month-on-month into June.

items.statement: GPI will be in lower single digit.
items.quote: It would be in lower single digit. That's the indication that I will be able to give you as of today.

items.statement: Gross margin for 9 months Express is 26.2%, up from 24%.
items.quote: Yes, so gross profit margin for the nine months of the Express business is 26.2%, which is a substantial growth over the similar period of 9 months of last year. It was 24%.

items.statement: Expects gross margin of 27% for current year.
items.quote: So, we, for the current year itself, we are looking at 27.

items.statement: Quick commerce B2B business growing strongly, higher than market.
items.quote: Yes, very good growth. We are growing much higher than the growth of the market. We operate with the large three quick commerce players who deliver shipments to your homes. So, that business is growing very, very strongly, ma'am.

items.statement: MSMEs under stress, approaching with caution.

items.statement: QIP allocation only for hub modernization, no fallback.

items.statement: Debt level to continue at 20-30 crores over next year.
items.quote: 20 to 30 crores is a debt level which we see to continue over a period of next year or so.

items.quote: We believe that our capex for the current year will be lower than FY2024, and this will continue to unwind in FY2026.

items.quote: I would say at headline, you should see moderation of capex even in FY2026, and with the revenue growths that we are seeing, the capex as a percentage of revenues will continue to trend downwards and soon be at the levels of global peers.

items.statement: Expects to fill gaps in a couple of circles and continue to benefit from sites deployed.

items.statement: Will launch comprehensive cloud solution in next few months.

items.statement: Hexacom capex directionally same, could marginally increase due to FWA rollout.
items.quote: So, directionally same could be marginal increase, it all depends on FWA rollout. As you know, that in terms of a footprint of the radio capex we had done and hence, there could be some increase because of the FWA capex but directionally, not very different.

items.statement: Hexacom addressable market about 3 to 4 million; present in close to 200 cities.
items.quote: In terms of addressable market, I would say this would be about 3 to 4 million. We are present in close to about 200 cities in Hexacom.

items.statement: Hexacom has about 2 million home passes currently.
items.quote: About 2 million home passes we have, currently at Bharti Hexacom

items.statement: Hexacom exceptional charge of 1.4 billion taken; no cash payout; one-time, no trend.
items.quote: Well as any other organization, there is a periodic review of the carrying value of various assets and liabilities, so in that review, it was felt that there is a provision which has to be taken. items.statement: Full impact of Gaana price revision to reflect from FY26 onwards.
items.quote: Since our pricing plans follow our annual subscription model, we expect the full impact of the price revision to reflect from FY '26 onwards.

items.statement: Invested INR10.5 crores in digital during the quarter, down 26% over Q1 FY25.
items.quote: We remain committed to strengthening our digital offerings, investing INR10.5 crores during the quarter, which is almost 26% down over Q1 FY '25.

items.statement: EBITDA excluding digital was INR38.8 crores with 28% margin.
items.quote: EBITDA excluding digital stood at INR38.8 crores with EBITDA margins at a healthy 28%.

items.quote: As you may recall, we launched an updated version of Gaana in July 2024 with a revised pricing moving from INR299 to INR599 for our annual pack pricing, and the response from customers has been highly encouraging.

items.statement: Radio business faced challenges from shorter festive season and media slowdown, impacting volumes.
items.quote: Our Radio business faced some challenges due to a shorter festive season and overall slowdown in the media markets, which impacted overall volumes.

items.statement: Digital revenue was 26% of total radio revenues in Q3 FY25 vs 13% last year.
items.quote: In Q3 FY '25, digital revenue accounted for 26% of our total radio revenues against last year of near 13%.

items.statement: Cash balance was INR344 crores as of December 31, 2024.
items.quote: Our balance sheet remains strong with a cash balance of INR344 crores as of December 31, 2024.

items.statement: International operations remained EBITDA positive, contributing INR2.1 crores in the quarter.
items.quote: Our international operations remain EBITDA positive, contributing INR2.1 crores in the quarter.

items.statement: Profit before tax for the quarter was INR22 crores.
items.quote: Profit before tax for the quarter stood at INR22 crores.

items.statement: Domestic revenue reached INR154 crores, up 9.7% year-on-year.
items.quote: During this quarter, our domestic revenue reached INR154 crores, marking a healthy 9.7% year-on-year growth.

items.statement: Non-FCT segment grew 21% year-on-year to INR50 crores.

items.statement: Digital business revenue reached INR15.4 crores, up 151% year-on-year.
items.quote: Our digital business continued to deliver exceptional growth with revenue reaching INR15.4 crores, up by 151% year-on-year, largely fuelled by the strong performance of Gaana.

items.statement: Core business excluding digital grew 3.2% year-on-year to INR138 crores.
items.quote: Excluding digital, our core business recorded a 3.2% year-on-year growth with revenue reaching INR138 crores.

items.statement: Paid subscriber growth at YTD levels was approximately 15%.
items.quote: At YTD levels, our paid subscriber growth has been healthy and in the range of approximately 15%.

items.statement: Radio contributes 63% of total revenues at YTD levels vs 71% last year.
items.quote: At YTD levels, radio contributes to 63% of our total revenues compared to almost 71% last year.

items.statement: Hopeful that next year should be better than this year.
items.quote: So we hope that next year should be better than this year.

items.statement: Hopeful that employee cost percentage will come down in FY25-26.
items.quote: But if you will see the next year, say FY25-26, I am hopeful that the percentage will come down.

items.statement: EBITDA margin should keep improving going forward.
items.quote: And that should keep on improving going forward.

items.statement: Spent INR50 crores this year on automation and modernization.
items.quote: This year also we have spent INR50 crores for different types of automation and other things which can be possible and something like that.

items.statement: Employee cost can come down by 2-2.5% once revenue goes up.
items.quote: Once the revenue goes up, automatically 2% - 2.5% can come down immediately.

items.statement: Delta between PET bottle and fiber price lower by INR3 to INR4 per kg this quarter.
items.quote: So the last year delta used to be higher by INR3 to INR4 per kg. And this year, in this quarter, particularly, delta has been lower by that much amount.

items.statement: Positive cycle for textile sector may start next financial year.

items.statement: Order flow should start improving after clarity in demand centers.
items.quote: We are hopeful that after the dust settles, some of our major demand centers will have more clarity and order flow should start improving.

items.statement: Domestic market expected to boost on budget benefits.

items.statement: Increasing non-apparel and value-added products like lycra twisted yarn.

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions and Red Sea crisis create uncertainty.
items.quote: So you see the uncertainty is there, geopolitical tensions, a lot of conflicts, Red Sea crisis, so many things have been happening worldwide.

items.statement: Turkey's worsening position due to interest rate hikes impacts dyed yarn demand.
items.quote: Positioning of key countries like Turkey has been worsening due to continuous increase in the interest rates, and consequent negative impact on the demand of the dyed yarn.

items.statement: Home textile exports to Middle East suffered due to problems.
items.quote: What happened that since there were problems in the Middle East, our exports to Middle East suffered very much.

items.statement: Hospital business margin guidance for current financial year around 20.5%.

items.statement: Targeting margin expansion year-on-year, ultimate target to reach 25% sooner than later.
items.quote: Yes, we are targeting margin expansion. And hopefully, we'll be seeing margi n improvement year-on-year. So our ultimate target is to reach to 25% sooner than later.

items.statement: Agilus expected to reach industry growth levels of 8-10% by second quarter of next year.
items.quote: So, as I told earlier, so the growth, what we are expecting somewhere around second quarter of next year is about 8% to 10% kind of overall growth, out of which it w ill be largely driven by volume and to some extent, by value, which will be due to the intensity of tests in the sense that the mix of tests that will have an influence on that.

items.statement: Brownfield bed additions estimated at 350 to 400 beds year-on-year.
items.quote: Yes. So we are estimating around this number, 350 to 400 type of number year -on-year. It all depends how quickly we can operationalize our brownfield expansion.

items.statement: Manesar facility expected to breakeven by first quarter next year.
items.quote: Neha, we are targeting this by first quarter next year.

items.statement: Manesar operating loss booked INR 12-13 crores in Q3.
items.quote: Yes. So Manesar, we have operationalized major operation in this quarter itself. And as a result, there is an operating loss we have booked INR 12 crores to INR 13 crores during this quarter.

items.statement: Rebranding expenses planned at INR 50 crores this year, major balance in Q4.
items.quote: We had planned to spend about INR 50 crores on rebranding this year. So I th ink over the last quarter and maybe a little bit flow through into next quarter may happen. So it will be in Q4 is what the major balance will happen in the Q4 respect.

items.statement: No one-off rebranding expenses planned for next year as of now.
items.quote: We have as such not planned anything as of now. So we will -- as of now, there's no one -off expenses planned. It will be part of the regular budget. But in case if we are having any carryover from this, we'll be doing it in the first quarter of next year.

items.statement: Gross debt around INR 2,300 crores and net debt around INR 2,000 crores after PE stake acquisition.
items.value: INR 2,300 crores gross, INR 2,000 crores net

items.statement: Legal costs expected to remain high early next year, then come down.
items.quote: So I think the early part of next year also, there will be some significantly higher legal costs. But post that, we should see these costs coming down.

items.statement: Confident to achieve 10,000 operating bed target over next 5 years.
items.quote: But we are pretty confident that overall, over the period of next 5 years, we should be able to get to our target.

It would be around INR10 crores whereas 50% would be the maintenance products.

items.statement: Internal margin target is higher than guidance, but difficult to achieve 18-19% margins due to competition and raw material prices.
items.quote: However, our internal margin target is still higher which we have given in the guidance.

items.statement: Injection molding business has 100% raw material cost pass-through contract with customers.
items.quote: On that front, we have a 100% contract with the customer. So it is a complete pass-through.

items.quote: And this year, we are not seeing any major increase in the trend so far. So it's more or less of a stable situation. In some places, the cost of materials are actually going down.

items.statement: Aftermarket business expected to contribute about 10% to total revenues over next few years.
items.quote: Over the next few years, this business is expected to contribute about 10% to the total revenues of the group.

items.quote: From business point of view, if you look at the total pie chart, injection business roughly is about 48% this year and extrusion business is roughly 52% this year.

items.quote: So there is a negative EBITDA of INR1.2 crores in this quarter also.

items.statement: Borrowings to be maintained at current level, not increased.

items.quote: So on the next 2 years to 3 years, we will try to maintain it that level only. After that, we will try to reduce the debt at the net level.
